entities.summary: Shah's White Revolution, a transformative movement in Iran (1963–1979). Emerged from Mossadegh nationalizes Iran's oil industry and CIA-MI6 coup d'état overthrows Mossadegh and restores the Shah's power. Catalyzed White Revolution and Opposition and White Revolution.
